nom: NIVEA MEN Maximum Hydration Face Scrub

avis.auteur: R A S C A L
avis.titre: MEN OF 2026, PLEASE STEP YOUR GAME UP!
avis.texte: Okay, listen here. It's 2026, you're FINALLY realizing you need to change up the routine and ACTUALLY take care of your hygiene and your appearance. Remember, you're doing this for yourself and no one else. With face wash, it was a struggle figuring out the right one for myself. I went from Cereva to Neutrogena, but I finally found my home with Nivea. Especially since that have skincare product made for men which is a huge plus. This face wash will literally leave your face feeling refreshed and not to mention it feels like you're giving yourself a massage due to the materials scrubbing your face to unclog your pores. Trust me, you'll get addict due to the results. Since this product contains Aloe Vera, it will leave a refreshing smell for a few seconds. But man I can't lie, the smell is kind of attractive. THAT'S JUST ME, everyone is different, but I promise you, the smell makes you feel mad refresh and ready to step out for GOOD TIME.
Been using this for years as it does a great job making my face feel fresh and clean.
Husband loves this product. Hard to find in stores. Great price and comes fast. Great that it’s a 3 pack to last awhile
This product is outstanding. A deep cleaning scrub with a pleasant scent. Easy to carry.
Idk why but my husband say it feel fresh and cool only for first few uses, then it just feel nothing.
Buen producto, limpia la cara muy bien y deja una sensación fresca

avis.titre: Si se encuentra disponible, no lo dudes.
avis.texte: Excelente producto, es prácticamente imposible conseguirlo en México, es un producto americano, la fórmula funciona muy bien, limpia el rostro completamente, todas las impurezas, lo recomiendo ampliamente.

avis.titre: Finally, an affordable scrub that's actually a SCRUB!
avis.texte: My introduction to scrubs were high-end products from Kiehl's and Clinique For Men. As much as I loved them, I wasn't keen on spending $20-$30 a month for a facial product. I've been searching for the past few years for an alternative scrub, and until now have come up empty. I was stunned at how many products call themselves scrubs, only to end up being creams, with little to no scrubbing properties. Finally, I have found the answer! This Nivea deep cleaning face scrub delivers all of the scrubbing power I've been looking for, making it an excellent pre-shave scrub and facial cleaner, suitable for daily use. Your search has ended, this is what you've been looking for!

avis.titre: Once it cracked I couldn't go back.
avis.texte: The product its self is fairly good and provides a deep clean. I'm a young man who is still producing a lot of face oils so this stuff is much needed for me. I would say when im using it in the winter there are times were my face feels a bit dry after use but its not to bad honestly. However, the reason for the four star comes from the bottles lack of structural integrity. I dropped it like a klutz while in the shower one day and the cap broke off. However, the nozzle on the cap got clogged with the excess plastic from the lid making it virtually impossible to getting anything out of it. I now have to forcibly take off the entire cap each time I want to use it. Not a whole lot Nivea can do about this so I'm not complaining. I suppose they could make the bottle slightly more durable for likely falls in the shower.
Love this face wash but two of my bottles were open and making a big mess. Hopefully Nivea can replace them and make everything right! We shouldn’t receive bottles that are open or damaged!

avis.titre: Great Product value compare to price!!!
avis.texte: I really love the product after using it for few times. I ordered the whole package with 3x Scrubs and the product has great value compared to the price. It really works with dry skin and dead skin. I love the product and would order it again.

avis.titre: Reformulated into uselessness by removing the ingredients that actually cleaned.
avis.texte: Reformulation gutted this product. I compared the old and new ingredient lists side by side and the new formula removed the actual cleansing surfactants: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate, Sodium Myreth Sulfate, and Decyl Glucoside are all gone, replaced with milder glucoside-based surfactants that don't have the cleaning power. Menthol is gone, so no more cooling sensation. Alcohol Denat is gone, so it doesn't cut oil the way it used to. What's left is essentially a gentle moisturizing cleanser with added retinyl palmitate and propylene glycol. Fine if you have dry sensitive skin. Useless if you bought a men's facial cleanser because you actually need to wash sweat, sunscreen, and sebum off your face. This is a classic "sulfate-free" reformulation chasing a marketing trend at the cost of the product actually working. The label looks friendlier. The product doesn't clean. Buying something else next time.

avis.titre: works ok, but package is not shipping friendly.
avis.texte: i tried this stuff to clean my face. works ok, and leaves me feeling somewhat clean... but the container or shipping method is horrible as the bottle bursts at the seams. When I opened up the box, it was leaking all over everything else. update: after using up the broken container, I still keep using the cleanser. my face feels somewhat cleaner afterwards, I still get breakouts and see oily and dry patches on my face. guess this stuff is not meant for my skin. still needs better packaging so it won't burst during shipping.
Received mine heavily damaged. One bottle was torn open and a piece of the cap for the other broke off in the spout so I cant get any of the soap out. A refund would be nice

First time that I received it can in only one tube. Second time came in 3. I like that it contains micro particles. They help with cleaning and also preparing the beard for a shave. Smells very strongly like alcohol though.

I was disappointed because I got the wrong product and even got less of a product. The product that was advertised was 4.4 Oz; I received 2.5 Oz. What I wanted Nivea Men Maximum Hydration Deep Cleaning Face Scrub. What I received was Nivea Men Maximum Hydration Face Lotion/ Sunscreen.
States that it is a "pack of 3" 4.4oz, definitely not a 3 pack, only received one.
